meta.title: Module Display by Menu Item
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Module Display by Menu Item".

steps.title: Snails
steps.text: Snails are slow, but they get there: a garden snail carries its house on its back wherever it goes.

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Module Display by Menu Item', 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules', '

A module shows on all pages by default. In this tour you choose the pages a module shows on: in Joomla, each menu item is a page.

The playground already has an article Snails and a menu item Snails in the Main Menu. You create a module Fun Fact that shows only on the Snails page, a module Site Maintenance that shows everywhere, and you hide the Login Form on the Snails page.

This tour follows the tutorial 9.2 Module Display by Menu Item of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_modules"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 9.2 Module Display by Menu Item', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Content › Site Modules', '

Click Site Modules in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Create a new module', '

Click New.

', 3, 'bottom', '.view-modules .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Custom', '

Click Custom.

', 4, 'right', '.view-select a.comModulesSelectCard[aria-label$=" Custom"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=select&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Module title', '

Type the title:

Fun Fact

Then click Next.

', 5, 'bottom', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_custom"]) #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Module content', '

Type a fun fact about snails in the editor, for example:

The average garden snail moves at a pace of roughly 3.6 to 47 meters per hour, depending on the species and conditions.

Then click Next.

', 6, 'top', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_custom"]) .tox-tinymce,.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_custom"]) #jform_content', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Position', '

Click the field Position and choose Sidebar-left [sidebar-left] in the group Cassiopeia. You can also type sidebar-left to find it.

Then click Next.

', 7, 'left', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_custom"]) fieldset.form-vertical:has(#jform_position)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Menu Assignment', '

Click the tab Menu Assignment.

', 8, 'bottom', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_custom"]) button[aria-controls="assignment"]', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Module Assignment', '

Choose Only on the pages selected.

A list of all menu items appears.

', 9, 'bottom', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_custom"]) #jform_assignment', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"1"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Choose the page', '

Click None to clear all checkboxes, then tick Snails.

Then click Next.

', 10, 'top', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_custom"]) #menuselect-group', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Open the save options', '

You create a second module right after this one. Click the arrow next to Save & Close.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_custom"]) #toolbar-dropdown-save-group .dropdown-toggle-split', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Save & New', '

Click Save & New.

Joomla saves the module and opens a new, empty Custom module, on the tab Menu Assignment.

', 12, 'left', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_custom"]) #save-group-children-save-new .button-save-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'The module Site Maintenance', '

The tab Menu Assignment shows On all pages: the default. Keep it.

  1. Click the tab Module.
  2. Title: Site Maintenance
  3. Text: Our site will be offline for maintenance this evening.
  4. Position: Sidebar-left [sidebar-left]

Then click Next.

', 13, 'top', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_custom"]) #module-form', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Save the module', '

Click Save & Close.

', 14, 'bottom', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_custom"]) #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Look at your site', '

Click this button with your site\'s name: your site opens in a new tab (in the Joomla Playground you can also click Site in its toolbar).

The home page shows Site Maintenance and the Login Form. Click Snails in the Main Menu: now Fun Fact shows too.

Come back to this tab and click Next.

', 15, 'bottom', '#header a.header-item-content[target="_blank"]', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Open the Login Form module', '

On the Snails page, the Login Form should not show. Click Login Form.

', 16, 'right', '.view-modules #moduleList a[title$=" Login Form"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Menu Assignment', '

Click the tab Menu Assignment.

', 17, 'bottom', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_login"]) button[aria-controls="assignment"]', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Module Assignment', '

Choose On all pages except those selected.

', 18, 'bottom', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_login"]) #jform_assignment', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"-1"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Choose the exception', '

Now the ticked pages are the pages where the module does not show.

Click None to clear all checkboxes, then tick Snails.

Then click Next.

', 19, 'top', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_login"]) #menuselect-group', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Save the module', '

Click Save & Close.

', 20, 'bottom', '.view-module:has(#jform_module[value="mod_login"]) #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-menu-item-modules'), 'Well done!', '

Look at your site again and reload the page: the Login Form shows on every page except Snails.

With Menu Assignment you choose the pages of a module: on all pages, only on the pages you select, or on all pages except those.

', 21, 'bottom', '#header a.header-item-content[target="_blank"]', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
